query:
SELECT count(DISTINCT rep_id) AS "count!"
               FROM v_order_facts
               WHERE ($1::date IS NULL OR ordered_on >= $1)
                 AND ($2::date IS NULL OR ordered_on < $2)
                 AND (NOT $3::boolean
                      OR ordered_on >= CURRENT_DATE - interval '12 months')
                 AND ($4::text = 'all' OR kind::text = $4)
